title: Ensuku z’Obugagga ezigenda zifa
intro: Mu nsi eyaweebwa omukisa n’ebintu bingi, ekitundu kyakulaakulana, nga kibeera wakati mu bubonero bw’ekisa eky’obwakatonda. Okukulaakulana kwabwe kwali bujulizi obw’okusiimibwa kwa Mukama waabwe, ekirabo ekyali kigendereddwamu okukubiriza okwebaza n’obuwulize. Kyokka, wadde nga byali biraga bulungi emikisa gyabwe, enkyukakyuka yatuuka, eyasomooza okusiima kwabwe eri ensibuko y’obugagga bwabwe obw’ekitalo n’okubudaabudibwa kwabwe.
clues: Twaweebwa omukisa n’ensuku bbiri, emu ku ddyo ate endala ku kkono, nga zijjudde ebibala.
Twalagirwa okulya ku mmere ya Mukama waffe n’okumwebaza olw’ettaka eddungi n’Omukama asonyiwa.
Twakula ne tuva mu kkubo ery’okwebaza, nga twewaana olw’obugagga n’obuyinza bwaffe.
Twasaba Mukama waffe ayongere ebanga wakati w’engendo zaffe, nga tulaga okunyooma obwangu bwe yali atuwadde.
Twalabulwa omubaka, naye twagaana obubaka ne tweyongerayo mu butafaayo bwaffe.
Ebbibiro lyaffe eddene eryayimirizaawo obugagga bwaffe, ku nkomerero yamenyeka, ekyaviirako amataba amangi ennyo.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
